description_en: Starts multiple applications at a time
name: BatchStartApplications

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the applications that you want to start. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，多个ID时使用半角逗号（,）分割
parameters.name: app_ids

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Take note of the following rules:

2xx: The call was successful.

3xx: The call was redirected.

4xx: The call failed.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_en:
The error code.

If the request is successful, this parameter is not returned.\\

This parameter is returned only if the request failed.\\ For more information, see Error codes in this topic

ChangeOrderId.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: indicates that the request was successful.

3xx: indicates that the request was redirected.

4xx: indicates that the request was invalid.

5xx: indicates that a server error occurred

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned if the request failed. Take note of the following rules:

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned if the request succeeds.

If the call fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the "Error codes" section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the trace. It is used to query the details of a request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the application deployment is successful. Take note of the following rules:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
批量启动应用是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：表示批量启动应用成功。
false：表示批量启动应用失败

TraceId.description_en: The ID of the change order
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
